title: Fine Arts Travel Fee Schedule: Ensemble Travel Rates for Band, Orchestra and Theatre, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
The scheduled ensemble travel rate of the Fine Arts travel fee schedule of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees**, for a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, is 160.00 for band or orchestra when the student's district enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year shows grade 06 or above, 120.00 for theatre when that record shows grade 09 or above, and otherwise the Fine Arts Performing Ensemble travel fee of the activity fee catalogue (145.00). The record read is the student's enrollment record for the school year kept by Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions.

| Ensemble | Grade on that record | Scheduled ensemble travel rate |
|---|---|---|
| band or orchestra | 06 to 12 | 160.00 |
| theatre | 09 to 12 | 120.00 |
| theatre | 06 to 08 | 145.00 (catalogue travel fee) |
| choir | any | 145.00 (catalogue travel fee) |
| any | no enrollment record in status enrolled | 145.00 (catalogue travel fee) |

Theatre's boundary is grade 09: grade 08 is below it, grade 09 on it.
